column1: 5.5.4.2.30 System Messages Window. In this window, messages related to system
commands exercised by user on SCD Main Window & their responses/ results received
from sub-systems shall be displayed in this window as on when they happen with the latest
message being on top of the list. By default, this window shall be hidden and shall be shown
when user selects ‘Show System Messages Window’ option in ‘System’ menu. The GUI
for this window shall be as shown in Figure-5.272 and shall contain GUI tabs to show each
